benchmark: acme-kw-bench (3 Enterprise Knowledge Work Tasks, k=3 Attempts / Task)

experiments.name: Sanity Floor (nop)
experiments.finding: PASS: Floor is 0.0% (no trivial passes or leaked answers in container image).

experiments.name: Sanity Ceiling (oracle)
experiments.finding: FAIL: Ceiling is only 66.7%! Task 2 (vendor-msa-compliance-audit) is impossible to pass due to /app vs /workspace path bug and offline pip install in test.sh.

experiments.name: Customer Baseline (Old Model)
experiments.finding: Customer's legacy prompt had hardcoded hints for Task 1's undocumented cents/heading schema and Task 3's SQL column name.

experiments.name: Customer Baseline (Gemini)
experiments.finding: Headline looks like 0% vs 66.7%, but Gemini actually computed the exact right math on all 3 tasks—blocked by Task 1 verifier bias, Task 2 broken test.sh, and Task 3 swallowed stderr + 8-turn cap!

experiments.name: Fixed Grader Only
experiments.finding: Fixing ONLY the biased verifier (Task 1) and broken test.sh (Task 2) lifts Gemini Pass@1 from 0.0% -> 77.8% without touching the agent or model.

experiments.name: Reference Harness Control
experiments.finding: 2x2 Control proves Gemini 3.1 Pro solves 100% (3/3 across all 3 seeds) when run in a clean reference harness.

experiments.name: Fixed Customer Harness
experiments.finding: Fixing stderr visibility, preserving thought_signature via google-genai SDK, and matching HIGH thinking effort achieves 100% Pass@1 & Pass^3 at 5x lower cost/resolved than the incumbent.
